title: Cardiopulmonary Rehabilitation in Chronic Stroke
brief_summary: This study is aimed to determine the effects of an accompanying structured cardiopulmonary rehabilitation program along with a neurorehabilitation program on the quality of life, care-giver burden and overall well-being of the patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* A history of ischemic stroke at least 6 months ago

Exclusion Criteria:

* any cardiac or pulmonary problem that renders the patient unavailable for the program
* mental impairment
* not being able to perform exercise testing
* not being able to walk independently
